title: Fractional-edge prism volume
observableEvidence: Calculates the volume of a rectangular prism with fractional edge lengths and labels the result with cubic units.
prompt: A rectangular prism has length 2 1/2 feet, width 1 1/2 feet, and height 4 feet. What is its volume?
solutionMethod: Convert mixed numbers to fractions, multiply the three edge lengths, and label the result in cubic units.

hintSteps.prompt: Volume counts layers of unit cubes, so combine all three edge lengths by multiplication.
hintSteps.question: What operation connects length, width, and height for a rectangular prism?

review.originalityStatement: New candidate item drafted from first principles for this repository; it does not reproduce or paraphrase proprietary or contest material.

accessibilityNotes: State the three fractional edge lengths and multiplication in text; no 3-D rendering is required.
accessibleAlternative: Read aloud or display: Multiply two and one-half feet, one and one-half feet, and four feet to find the prism's volume in cubic feet.
